title: Avoid radar charts, whose shapes change with the order of their spokes.
rule: Leave radar charts out of every Oath & Action piece. Draw the same measures as a dot plot on one scale, or as small-multiple bars with one panel per group, so each value is read as a position or a length from zero.
use_when: Never: a reader who asks how several groups compare across the same measures gets a truer answer from a dot plot or small-multiple bars.

use_instead.when: Each group has one value on each of several measures and the reader compares positions
The reader compares each group's mix of measures, panel by panel
Two to four groups are compared within each measure

text: A radar chart draws values as a shape, and a shape's area grows with the square of its values, so a group a little ahead on every spoke looks far bigger. Moving one spoke to another place changes every shape on the chart with no change in the data, and overlapping outlines hide each other.
why.basis: Design judgment, from the chart system our founder and editor approved in November 2026

builders: No form: the kit draws no radar chart. The sketch is work/build/guide/specimens/s-14-24-sketch.html, drawn small; build the better choice with the dot-plot or small-multiple-bars form.
